test_title: PYST 62: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Indira PP Bora is a Padma Shri Awardee 2020 for her contribution to which Indian classical dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sattriya** is one of the eight major Indian classical dance forms.
 
• It originated in the 15th century Assam, attributed to the Vaishnavite saint **Sankaradeva**.
 
• This dance form was initially performed in **monasteries (Sattras)** as a part of the Ankiya Naat (a form of Assamese one-a14ct plays).
 
• Sattriya was recognized as a classical dance by the Sangeet Natak Akademi in **2000**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sattriya Dance**

 
 
• Sattriya is a combination of **music, dance, and drama**.
 
• The dance was traditionally performed by male monks, known as Bhakats, within the confines of the monasteries.
 
• It includes both **nritta (pure dance)** and **nritya (expressive dance)** forms.
 
• The themes of Sattriya dances are mostly based on the **mythological stories** of Krishna and Vishnu.
 
• The costumes used in Sattriya are usually made of white or off-white silk with embroidered patterns.
 
• Musical instruments used in Sattriya include the **Khol (drum)**, **Taals (cymbals)**, and the **Flute**.
 
 
 
• **Kathak**
 
 
• Kathak is a North Indian classical dance form known for its intricate footwork and spins.
 
• It traces its origins to the wandering bards of ancient northern India known as Kathakars or storytellers.
 
• It is characterized by its rhythmic foot movements, adorned with small bells (Ghungroo).
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi**
 
 
• Kuchipudi is a classical Indian dance form from Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It involves a combination of rhythmic footwork, dramatic characterization, and expressive eye movements.
 
• This dance form is known for its graceful movements and strong narrative/dramatic character.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam**
 
 
• Bharatanatyam is a South Indian classical dance form originating from Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork.
 
• Bharatanatyam is deeply rooted in Hindu religious themes and mythology.
 
• It is known for its elaborate costumes, intricate jewelry, and expressive hand gestures (Mudras).
